title: 1. Asymmetric Cryptography
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L08: Cryptography 2 (Asymmetric, PKI, TLS, Signatures): 1. Asymmetric Cryptography .

items: Key pair — public (share freely) + private (keep secret)
100–1000× slower than symmetric, but solves key distribution
Linear scaling — only 2n keys for n users (vs n(n−1)/2 for symmetric)

blocks.text: Mnemonic: "Public for Encryption, Private for Signature." Mix these up and you've built an oracle, not a secret.
